Biggest leaks (estimated, overlapping, not additive)
  1. Repeated tool results: ~$4.50 (estimated), 60K tokens (estimated)
     Do this: trove optimize status
     duplicate_result_collapser can remove this. Nothing is offered or switched
     on until the baseline period ends (see Optimizers).
  2. Noisy tool output: ~$3.00 (estimated), 90K tokens (estimated)
     Do this: trove optimize status
     noise_normalizer can remove this. Nothing is offered or switched on until
     the baseline period ends (see Optimizers).
  3. Prompt cache misses: ~$1.35 (estimated), 27K tokens (estimated)
     Cache misses happen when the start of a request changes between turns.
     Avoid editing early context mid-session.

Optimizers
  Baseline in progress: day 3 of 7 and 30 of 20 sessions. Until both pass, every
  optimizer only estimates and changes nothing.
  volatile_prefix_mover: off
  noise_normalizer: shadow (set to on)
    Saved ~$0.50 (estimated).
  output_trimmer: off
  duplicate_result_collapser: off
    Would have saved ~$3.60 (estimated, shadow mode).
  cache_breakpoints: off
  Guardrail events: none.
